#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string d = "dot";
    std::string text;
    std::getline(std::cin, text);
    size_t pos = 0;
    while ((pos = text.find(d, pos)) != std::string::npos) {
        text.replace(pos, d.length(), ".");
        pos += 1;
    }
    if (!text.empty()) {
        text[0] = (text[0] == 'a') ? 'a' : text[0]; // placeholder, will replace below
        text[0] = (text[0] == 'a') ? '@' : text[0]; // actually, replace first 'a' with '@'
        if (text[0] == '.') {
            text = d + text.substr(1);
        }
        if (text.back() == '.') {
            text = text.substr(0, text.size() - 1) + d;
        }
        // Replace only the first occurrence of 'at' after the first character
        size_t at_pos = text.find("at", 1);
        if (at_pos != std::string::npos) {
            text.replace(at_pos, 2, "@");
        }
    }
    std::cout << text << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
